findings.summary: closeMenu() never removes the outside-click listener added in openMenu(), so it leaks and stacks on every open/close cycle.
findings.mechanism: openMenu() calls document.addEventListener('click', onClickOutside) each time it runs, but closeMenu() only removeEventListener's 'keydown', not 'click'. Every open→close cycle leaves onClickOutside permanently attached to document, and the next open adds a duplicate — listener count grows unbounded and continues firing after the menu is closed, violating the stated cleanup requirement.
